sources.snippet: Full GRPO fine-tuning Qwen2.5 0.5B on a single T4 This colab uses a lot of tweaks and tricks to make GRPO full fine-tuning Qwen2.5-0.5-Instruct fit on a single T4 GPU, so that it could be run in a free Google Colab. It uses VLLm for fast inference and does not make compromises on batch and completion group sizes.
